Decision 1 and P8 still stop playback early, now at expiry minus 0.1 seconds. A player finishing at expiry minus 0.05 seconds would still be prematurely timed out. Tests explicitly avoid advancing directly to expiry, leaving the original deadline behavior and preservation of played_ms at that boundary unverified.
P8 retains output ownership until wait returns, including during termination escalation, and tests a queued successor behind a player that ignores termination.
